name: Havelyn Hair Food Oil 200ml | 7 Oils & 30+ Herbal Extracts for Strong & Healthy Hair
description:
Havelyn Hair Food Oil is a premium blend of 7 natural oils and over 30 herbal extracts that deeply nourishes and strengthens hair. This 200ml formula revitalizes roots, reduces hair fall, promotes natural growth, and improves scalp health. Free from harsh chemicals, it is safe for daily use on all hair types, leaving hair smooth, silky, and radiant. Suitable for both men and women, it restores natural shine, softness, and overall hair vitality.
Key Features
 7 natural oils including coconut, amla, almond, castor, olive, and mustard
 30+ herbal extracts for deep nourishment of scalp and roots
 Strengthens hair roots, minimizes breakage and hair fall
 Promotes thick, healthy natural hair growth
 Fights dandruff, dryness, and scalp roughness
 Restores shine, softness, and natural radiance
 Chemical-free formula, safe for all hair types
How to Use
 Apply a generous amount to scalp and hair
 Massage gently for 5–10 minutes
 Leave for at least 1 hour or overnight for best results
 Wash with mild shampoo
Material
Coconut oil, amla, almond, castor, olive, mustard, and herbal extracts
Safety Information
 For external use only
 Avoid contact with eyes
 Keep out of reach of children
 Discontinue if irritation occurs
Package Includes
 1 × 200ml Havelyn Hair Food Oil
